title: Reading Drill — Learning from a Damaged Mural
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Learning from a Damaged Mural
passages.body:
**A** A conservator found patches of pale colour on an outdoor mural. Instead of guessing whether sun or rain caused them, she recorded their shape on a transparent sheet.

**B** The patches matched positions where drips ran from a projecting ledge. To test this link, she observed the wall after light rain and compared the wet areas with her sheet.

**C** The conservator advised fitting a narrow gutter before retouching the paint. Repairing the image without controlling the drips might have produced another round of damage.
